referenceImages.name: Hawk Hill Battery Commander Station
referenceImages.scope: Whole independent low concrete Battery Commander Station at the Hawk Hill summit: complete closed body, screened panoramic observation slit, projecting slab and intrinsic stone/earth camouflage roof. Adjacent elevated radar platform, north watch pad, trails, natural hill and separate lower casemates are excluded and remain separate models. This associated historic summit structure alone does not complete the GGRO observation facility.
